_comment: Everything the dashboard's Apply kit lets you copy. Edit any value, save, and refresh the dashboard (no restart needed). Lines starting with EDIT ME are placeholders: replace them with your real answer. Your phone number is left out on purpose; add one {label, value} line to profile if you want it.

answers.label: Work authorization / how you work
answers.value: I am based in Nigeria and work as an independent contractor (B2B). I can invoice through Wise, Payoneer or Deel.

answers.label: Availability / start date
answers.value: Available after a 4-week notice period (currently employed).

answers.label: Years of experience
answers.value: 3+ years building production web and mobile products with React, TypeScript, Next.js and React Native across fintech, telecom, food delivery and crypto.

answers.label: Full-time or contract?
answers.value: Open to both full-time and long-term contract roles.

answers.label: Current role
answers.value: Frontend Engineer at East Atlantic Telecoms (09/2025 to present). I build the mobile (React Native) and web (Next.js) app for a fintech lending platform with peer-to-peer loans, and a multi-role captive portal internet platform with customer, admin, organization and advertiser interfaces.

answers.label: Tech stack
answers.value: TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, React Native, TailwindCSS, RTK Query, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Jest, Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Git, GitHub Actions, AWS, NX, Vite.

answers.label: Fintech experience
answers.value: Built a mobile and web fintech lending app with peer-to-peer loans, secure token management, session timeout handling, and in-app and push notifications. At FoodEx, I integrated Paystack, Direct Debit and Payment Links for secure checkout.

answers.label: Dashboards and role-based access
answers.value: Built analytics dashboards with financial metrics, charts, active WiFi sessions, top-performing services and payment management, and implemented role-based access control across four user types (customer, admin, organization, advertiser).

answers.label: Working with stakeholders
answers.value: I work directly with stakeholders and users to turn requirements into shipped features, and with backend engineers, designers and product managers to deliver across web and mobile.

answers.label: A project you're proud of
answers.value: Swap-Space, an invite-only home exchange platform. I built the full UI of the MVP with Next.js, TailwindCSS and RTK Query, including reusable components, search and filters, real-time chat and animations. It launched and onboarded 100 founding members in the first month, with 45% listing their homes.

answers.label: Education
answers.value: Diploma in Frontend Engineering, AltSchool Africa (2023). B.Sc. Agricultural Extension (with Distinction), Federal University of Agriculture, Abeokuta (2023).
